items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And Joe Wilder was in the band... when I was with Cozy.* Oh, I forgot about Cozy. I was with Cozy too.

ctx.x: You laid it down, but they didn't issue it...is that it?

No, we didn't do it because Charlie Ventura had recorded it earlier for that label, see? And, ooohhh, they were mad about that one. But I did "Manteca" and then "Body and Soul" and I think it was "Oo Bop Sha Bam", that I did. And, you know, everyone was a soloist in that band, you know, and Joe Wilder, he had sixteen bars and that's all he had, you know what I mean, he was a great trumpet player, and we used to wait for that sixteen bars. I think he did it on "Wouldn't You", yeah. That sixteen bars was so tasty.…
